findings.description: Decision 60 says `state` is left unsanitized because it is "checked on write," but this PR's final commit sanitizes `state` and its own new comment says the opposite (no CHECK constraint exists) — the decision doc now contradicts the code the same PR ships.
findings.body:
Decision 60 (added earlier in this PR by commit `4d85f8d`) records:

> ...so the snapshot now passes a session row's `id` and `branch` through `sanitizeReason` like its other stored text (decision 29; `pup report` already did), leaving `state`, which is checked on write.

This commit's own new comment in `src/core/dashboard.service.ts` directly refutes that premise:

> ...and no CHECK constraint holds `state` to its type, so it is scrubbed like the others.

`sessions.state` in `src/core/db.client.ts` has no `CHECK` clause (contrast `ledger_entries.status`, which does) — the code comment is right, and decision 60's rationale for skipping `state` no longer holds now that `state` *is* sanitized (`state: sanitizeReason(row.state) as SessionState`). Since `AGENTS.md` designates `docs/09-decisions.md` as binding for future work ("Read 09 before implementing anything it touches"), an agent later touching this code would read decision 60 and conclude `state` doesn't need sanitizing — exactly the bug this PR just fixed. Decision 60 needs an addendum noting the "checked on write" premise didn't hold and `state` is now sanitized alongside `id`/`branch`.

<https://github.com/AlexisBalayre/pupitre/blob/cb39d3b5e8cea180624172018bf29c55cfc692c4/docs/09-decisions.md#L2892-L2895>

findings.description: `state: sanitizeReason(row.state) as SessionState` force-casts an arbitrary sanitized string into the 7-member `SessionState` union with no runtime check that it's actually a member; a corrupted/foreign value (as the commit's own test proves: `'running [2J'` is not a `SessionState`) silently falls through `STATE_COLOURS[session.state]` as `undefined` rather than the type-promised `string`. Confirmed cosmetic-only today (no exhaustive switch over `SessionState`, no security-relevant equality gate reads this field), but the `as` assertion overstates what `sanitizeReason` can guarantee.
